result.instructions: Tools for Go2Clock, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who clocked in late at our salon this week?"; "Download the timesheet CSV for the last 7 days."; "Show the rota for employee 10002 for next week.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Go2Clock data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run go2clock_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run go2clock_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run go2clock_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. go2clock_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: go2clock_list_users
tools.title: List clock users
tools.description: List every clock user with id, name, department, shift, payroll number and manager flag. Clock PINs are removed. Go2Clock API: POST /api/users/.

tools.name: go2clock_list_employees
tools.title: List employee details
tools.description: List employee details: contact, department, trade, pay rates, roles, start and termination dates. Go2Clock API: POST /api/employees/.

tools.name: go2clock_list_clock_records
tools.title: List clock records for a day
tools.description: List every clocking record (punch) for one date. Go2Clock API: POST /api/punches/ with punch_date.

annotations.title: List clock records for a day

tools.name: go2clock_list_clock_records_range
tools.title: List clock records for a date range
tools.description: List clocking records between two dates, optionally for one employee. Keep the range to 7 days or fewer per call; Go2Clock advises against larger pulls. Go2Clock API: POST /api/punches_range/.

annotations.title: List clock records for a date range

tools.name: go2clock_get_timesheet_csv
tools.title: Get timesheet CSV
tools.description: Generate the timesheet report as CSV for up to 7 days, optionally for one department or one employee. Returns the CSV text. Go2Clock API: POST /api/timesheet_csv_v1.

start_date.description: First day of the report, yyyy-mm-dd.

dept.description: Department name to filter by (default: all departments).

tools.name: go2clock_get_rota
tools.title: Get employee rota
tools.description: Read an employee's rota (shift schedule) between two dates: shift name, colour and planned hours per day. Go2Clock API: GET /api/employee_rota.

tools.name: go2clock_update_employee
tools.title: Update employee details
tools.description: Change some details of one existing employee. Send only the fields to change. Go2Clock API: PUT /api/employee_update. Does not change sign-in passwords or roles.

tools.name: go2clock_upload_employees
tools.title: Create or update employees
tools.description: Upload a list of employees (new or changed). Go2Clock keys each record on userid. Sends a JSON array. Go2Clock API: PUT /api/employees/. Does not set passwords or roles.

tools.name: go2clock_upload_clock_record
tools.title: Add a clock record
tools.description: Add one clocking record (punch) for an employee. Go2Clock refuses a duplicate record. Go2Clock API: PUT /api/punches/.

checktype.description: 0 = in, 1 = out, or another number your instance uses.

tools.name: go2clock_create_rota
tools.title: Create rota shifts
tools.description: Put a named shift on an employee's rota for one or more days from a start date. An existing rota entry on the same date is replaced. The shift name must match a shift in Go2Clock's shift settings. Go2Clock API: POST /api/employee_rota.

start_date.description: First day of the shift, yyyy-mm-dd.

shift_name.description: Shift name exactly as set in Go2Clock shift settings.

nodays.description: Consecutive days from the start date (default 1).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Go2Clock
prompts.description: What you can do with Go2Clock here, with example requests to try.
